about.title: About Me
bio: My name is Arturo, although many know me as [[R2]]. I studied TSAFAD, but after several years dedicating myself to it, I decided to make a shift towards the tech sector —another of my great passions— driven by my interest in creating, building, and solving.

I've been in contact with computers since I was little, although it wasn't until 2022 that I started to delve into the world of programming. In January 2025, I made the decision to train seriously and in a structured way. Since then, I've developed multiple projects and have many more in mind that I'd like to carry out and monetize.
I consider myself a [[self-taught]] person; learning on my own has been a constant in my life and that has made me resourceful, independent, and always in search of new solutions.

seo.ogDescription: Explore the portfolio of Arturo Alba García — frontend development, animations, and interactive UI.

description: Professional internship at NTT DATA within the Java SE + Spring Boot training program. The program covered six technical areas: backend development with Java and Spring Boot (RESTful services), software quality with JUnit 5 and Mockito (coverage over 85%), data management in PostgreSQL, frontend with Angular, AI integration, and a final integrative project.

The final project involved technical leadership in developing a complete solution, coordinating the full SDLC from requirements to deployment. In parallel, I participated in the Java SE Programmer Certification Preparation by NTT DATA / Oracle, diving deep into Java core (multithreading, lambdas, streams, concurrency, and memory management).
achievements: Backend Development with Java + Spring Boot: implemented robust RESTful services, optimizing business logic and ensuring system scalability. Deep command of the Spring ecosystem (Boot, Data, Security), microservices architecture, and enterprise application lifecycle management.

Software Quality (Testing): created unit and integration test suites with JUnit 5 and Mockito, guaranteeing code coverage above 85%. Testing-First mindset, ability to isolate dependencies for unit testing, and efficient debugging of complex errors.

Data Management: modeled and administered PostgreSQL schemas, optimizing complex SQL queries to improve response time. Relational database optimization, normalized schema design, and transaction management.

Frontend Development with Angular: built dynamic, responsive, component-based user interfaces connected to APIs through services. Reactive programming (RxJS), frontend state management, and Single Page Application (SPA) development.

Artificial Intelligence Integration: explored and implemented AI-based solutions for task automation and data analysis within the project environment. LLM integration, effective prompt design, and workflow with generative AI APIs.

Final Project: technical leadership in developing a complete solution end-to-end, coordinating the full SDLC from requirements to deployment. Complex problem-solving under agile methodologies, interdisciplinary teamwork, and end-to-end software vision.

Java SE Programmer Certification Preparation (NTT DATA / Oracle Training): advanced training aimed at Oracle Professional Certification. Deep knowledge of Java core (multithreading, lambdas, streams, concurrency, memory management) and programming best practices under international standards.

description: React component system with full TypeScript typing. Professional build with tree-shaking, ESM & CJS builds, and GSAP + Lenis integrated for smooth animations.
4 core components (Button, Stack, AnimatedBackground, Text) + 1 custom hook. Interactive documentation in Storybook and official npm publication.

details.title: Polymorphic Components
details.text: Button and Text are polymorphic components that adapt their HTML structure based on context (button, a, div, span...). Stack provides a flexible Flex container with full control over direction, gap, and alignment.

details.title: AnimatedBackground Canvas
details.text: Canvas component that generates abstract particle animations. Configurable duration, density, and colors. Integrated with GSAP for precise timeline control and smooth transitions.

details.title: Tree-shakable & Dual Builds
details.text: Production-optimized package: ESM exports for modern bundlers and CJS for legacy compatibility. Tree-shaking guarantees only the used code reaches production.

details.title: Tech Stack
details.text: TypeScript 79% · CSS 19.4% · JS 1.6%. 147 commits, 9 releases (latest v0.2.5 Aug 2025). MIT license. Direct Tailwind CSS integration and auto-theme support with zero configuration.

listening-maze.shortDescription: Active listening game in English with JSON-driven scalable levels
description: Audio navigation game where the player follows English instructions to find the maze exit. JSON-driven level system for maximum scalability.
Designed for touch and responsive. Immediate visual feedback for every player action. Integrated into English Web as the main Game Center exercise.

details.title: JSON Scalable Levels
details.text: Each level is defined in a JSON file with maze structure, audio instructions, and metadata. Adding new levels requires no code changes — just add an entry to the array.

details.title: Audio Guidance in English
details.text: Spoken English instructions guide the player through the maze. Integrated audio system that plays clear, progressively more complex directions based on the level.

details.title: Interactive Grammar Cards
details.text: After completing each maze, grammar cards display vocabulary and structures used. Positive reinforcement that connects gameplay with learning.

details.title: Responsive & Touch-friendly
details.text: Touch controls optimized for tablets and smartphones. Virtual D-pad and action buttons adapted for touch screens without losing navigation precision.

english-web.shortDescription: Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS educational platform for learning English
description: My first complete project: an interactive exercise and educational game platform built 100% with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. JSON-driven architecture for zero-dependency scalability.
104 commits of hand-written code. Includes grammar exercises, vocabulary, listening comprehension, and the Game Center with Listening Maze as the flagship feature.

details.title: Vanilla Architecture
details.text: HTML 37.1% · CSS 32.4% · JS 30.5%. Zero external dependencies. Everything written from scratch to master fundamentals before using frameworks or libraries. Optimal performance and minimal size.

details.title: JSON-driven Game Levels
details.text: Exercise and level content is stored in JSON structures. Adding new content (questions, vocabulary, maps) requires no HTML changes — just update the data.

details.title: Game Center Integration
details.text: English Web integrates multiple educational games under unified navigation. Listening Maze is the flagship, with grammar cards and per-session progress tracking.

details.title: Learning-first Design
details.text: Every interaction is designed to reinforce learning: immediate feedback, difficulty progression, and spaced repetition. Clean interface that prioritizes education over visuals.
